text:
Leah: heads-up — we need to run a short enablement "mini-sprint" for five mid-market accounts next week to finish migrations and capture feedback before renewal reviews. who can help run office hours + a focused workshop?
Marco: I can host the office hours for EMEA-friendly times. prefer 2 x 1hr sessions vs one long session.
Priya: happy to run a technical deep-dive (examples, payload tuning). can do Wed/Thu mornings PT.
Tom: I can jump into one of the sessions for runtime tuning and cost tips.
Leah: rough constraints: customers want a short workshop (30–45m) + a 1hr follow-up office hour in their timezone. goal = enable self-serve migration + gather feature asks.
Marco: propose schedule options (UTC):
```
A) Tue 14:00 UTC — Workshop 45m + Office hour 15:15 UTC (1hr)
B) Wed 09:00 UTC — Workshop 45m + Office hour 10:00 UTC (1hr)
C) Thu 20:00 UTC — Workshop 45m + Office hour 21:00 UTC (1hr)
```
Leah: polling for availability — reply with A/B/C or "call me" if you want to pair-run. please include timezone if it's outside EMEA/US.
Priya: B for me (9:00 UTC). can present migration checklist + code snippets.
Tom: C works best — evening slot reduces overlap with my deployment window.
Marco: A or B both ok. leaning B to cover APAC overlap.
Leah: ok looks like B wins. Priya and Marco will co-host the workshop; Tom will join the office hour for runtime/cost. I’ll create calendar invites.
Leah: draft workshop agenda (short):
- 0–5m: intros & goals
- 5–20m: migration checklist + common gotchas (Priya)
- 20–35m: live demo: small model swap + quantization tips (Marco/Tom)
- 35–45m: Q&A + next steps
Leah: office hour goal: hands-on assistance with their migration runs + capture feedback and any renewal risk signals. please add 1–2 probing questions for customers in the follow-up survey.
Priya: suggested survey Qs: "rate readiness to go to prod", "any blockers (infra/latency/cost)?", "feature requests or missing docs?"
Tom: also ask about observed token cost per request — helps prioritization for optimize recommendations.
Marco: I’ll add an agenda slide with rollout checklist + links to quickstart and `rbw` CLI snippets.
Ava-bot: calendar invite created: "Enablement mini-sprint — Workshop + Office Hour" Wed 09:00 UTC (1769952000) — invite sent to customers + CS owners.
Leah: thanks Ava-bot. Marco/Priya/Tom — can you drop 2–3 prep bullet points in this thread by EOD tomorrow so I can attach them to the invites?
Priya: prepping code snippets and a minimal repro repo link.
Tom: I’ll prepare a short list of runtime knobs + a couple of example perf numbers.
Marco: I’ll prepare the rollout checklist + a TL:DR slide on quantization tradeoffs.
Leah: perfect. post-session we’ll run the short survey and follow up on any renewal risk flags within 48h. :thumbsup:
Marco: :thumbsup:
Priya: :raised_hands:
Tom: :rocket:
